provenance: Computed by the LunarWindow pipeline from NASA LOLA terrain and NASA SPICE (DE421) ephemerides. Code written with AI assistance (Claude Code) and verified by the team with automated tests and a comparison against NASA PGDA illumination maps.
verdict: Touchdown 2028-09-06T13 UTC: the Sun's centre is 0.51 deg above the skyline and the top of Earth's disc 5.49 deg above the skyline (power and a link at landing).
Over 14 days: Sun up 94%, Earth in view 51%, both 51% of the time.
Survives the mission: the battery never drops below 140 Wh (lowest 691 Wh).
Longest darkness 20 h: that is the cold soak.
Battery used on this mission: 9 Wh of the 560 Wh it can use above its 140 Wh floor.
Battery model: power = panel power x visible Sun, whatever the Sun's direction (a sun-tracking array), so survival is an upper bound for fixed panels.
why: Darkest spell from 2028-09-13T20 UTC (20 h): terrain 60 m away blocks it (bearing 31 deg: skyline 1.65 deg, centre of the body at 1.52 deg).
Longest Earth blackout from 2028-09-13T17 UTC (164 h): terrain 90 m away blocks it (bearing 153 deg: skyline 1.56 deg, centre of the body at -4.73 deg).
